message.content:
Colored pencils with a wax/clay core fall under heading 9609. Subheading 9609.10 covers pencils and crayons with leads encased in a rigid sheath. The statistical suffix is 9609.10.00 with the 10-digit form 9609.10.0000.

Since the pencils are sold in a set in a tin, the set classification must be considered. The essential character is given by the pencils, and the tin is just packaging, so the set stays in 9609.10.

The 2022 HTSUS lists 9609.10.00 (Pencils and crayons, with leads encased in a rigid sheath) with statistical suffix 9609.10.0000 (as shown by a CBP ruling). The 10-digit code is 9609.10.0000.

{"hts_code": "9609.10.0000", "reason": "Wood-cased colored pencils with wax/clay cores (leads encased in a rigid sheath) are classified in heading 9609, subheading 9609.10, with the tin serving only as packaging."}
